answer: A newcomer earns standing only through returning customers. First deals count for almost nothing: the bridge to real privileges opens only when the same stranger comes back a second and third time for more work, each return recorded on an ivory ledger anyone can inspect. A saffron flag marks accounts whose customers never return, keeping them on small reversible jobs until strangers choose them again. A farm fails because its fakes can stage one-off deals, but cannot fake strangers who genuinely return, and paying fifty fakes to keep coming back costs more than the standing is worth.
